summary.text: Mike Schlossberg is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 132 who has served since December 1, 2012 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He works as a vice president of member relations and applied technology.

paragraphs.text: Mike Schlossberg earned a B.A. in political science and psychology from Muhlenberg College in 2005 and an M.A. in political science from Lehigh University in 2006.
His professional experience includes working as the vice president of member relations and applied technology.
For the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists Schlossberg's committee assignment as the Rules Committee.
